purpose: A third, independent re-reproduction of the restore drill, run by a third agent from a cold checkout of the same branch, provisioning its own database, roles, schema, and dataset from scratch rather than reusing any prior drill's data or environment.

environment.server_kind: unprivileged single-user cluster (initdb + pg_ctl, no root, no Docker) via voyn-artifacts/VOYN-W0-AICC-HOSTS-LACK-DB-AND-DOCKER/pg_test_harness.sh, SCRAM auth, loopback only

dataset.description: Synthetic production-shaped dataset seeded through the aicc_app role after a full bootstrap + migrate + apply_table_grants provisioning pass (all 14 migrations applied, 55 relations incl. views), bulk-loaded with generate_series.

procedure.provisioning: command_center.db.roles.apply_bootstrap + command_center.db.migrations.upgrade (as aicc_migrator) + command_center.db.roles.apply_table_grants, called directly from a standalone script rather than via the pytest fixtures, to exercise the same provisioning path a real recovery would use.
procedure.timed_window: target database creation (CREATE DATABASE) through the post-restore information_schema.tables count -- the wait an operator experiences during a real recovery. Excludes argument parsing and checksum verification, which precede the timer.

result.variance: flat 3s across all 4 runs, one backup archive reused for all 4 restores
result.conclusion: Confirms the order of magnitude of both prior drills (2026-08-27: 2s flat; 2026-09-01: 2-3s) with a third, fully independent provisioning pass -- own database, own role passwords, own seed script, same unprivileged harness but a freshly initialized cluster instance from this session. The restore step is real, reproducible, and not sensitive to which agent or seeding method produces the dataset, at this dataset size.

reproduction.seed_note: Seeded with a scratch script (not checked into the repository, same disposition as both prior drills) bulk-inserting via generate_series through the aicc_app role, matching the row shape (task/session/run/run_event) used by tests/db/test_postgres_integration.py's _seed_run helper.
reproduction.harness_note: PostgreSQL provisioned without root or Docker access via voyn-artifacts/VOYN-W0-AICC-HOSTS-LACK-DB-AND-DOCKER/pg_test_harness.sh (start/stop an unprivileged initdb+pg_ctl cluster on a high port), the same harness tests/db/conftest.py assumes via AICC_TEST_PG_ADMIN_DSN.
steps: create a scratch database, create/ALTER the four product roles cluster-wide
seed task/session/run/run_event as aicc_app via generate_series bulk inserts

additional_verification: Also re-ran the full tests/db/test_postgres_integration.py suite (28 tests) against the same harness; all passed, including test_backup_restore_drill_round_trips_data, confirming the --measure-out artifact-writing code path still works end to end.
